content.text: Well, thank you so much, Sarah.
content.trans: 英语：很好，莎拉。

content.text: It's a pleasure.
content.trans: 英语：It's a pleasure.

content.text: Yeah, we'll have you back very soon.
content.trans: 是的，我们很快就会把您召回。

content.text: So, all right, we're out of time, but we'll be back tomorrow with another lesson.
content.trans: 英语：所以，一切就绪，我们已经结束时间了，但明天我们将有另一堂课。

content.text: And be sure to visit our website.
content.trans: 英语：And be sure to visit our website.

content.text: Don't forget that Englishbot.com has many, many resources and also a community of users
content.trans: 英语：不要忘记，英语bot.com 有很多资源和一个用户社区。

content.text: and teachers that can help you answer questions and interact with you.
content.trans: 和能帮助你回答问题并与你互动的老师。

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: And you should definitely leave your suggestions.
content.trans: 您应该果断地离开您的建议。

content.text: But for now, I wish you all well.
content.trans: 但是，现在我要告诉你所有的事情。

content.text: And bye.
content.trans: 英语：And goodbye.
